to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the November 20, 2002/Kartika 29, 1924 (Saka)

(Ministries:  Coal and Mines; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional

Rehabilitation camps in Gujarat
*21. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
 Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether all the families living in
various rehabilitation camps in Gujarat after
Godhra incident have since gone back to
their native homes; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Stationing NSG’s at all State
capitals
*22.  DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several people
died in terrorist attack on Akshardham
Temple in Gujarat recently (September,
2002);
(b) the time taken by NSG commandos
to reach Ahmedabad from Delhi and start
the operation; and
(c) whether Government propose to
station NSGs at all State capitals to
tackle such terrorists’ attacks without
wasting time in flight for their movements
from Delhi?
Stagnation of underground mining
*23. SHRI GAYA SINGH:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
 Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
underground mining of coal has stagnated
over a decade resulting in increase in coal
imports;
(b) if so, the details of the production
from underground coal mines in the country
during the last ten years and imports of coal
during those years; and
(c) whether Government have plans to
increase production of coal from
underground mines; if so, the details thereof?
Drinking water projects in Orissa
*24. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of projects taken up in
Orissa under Rajiv Gandhi National
Drinking Water Mission;
(b) the present status of work on the
projects; and

(c) the fresh steps taken by Government
for early completion of the projects?
Joint Indo-Russian probe into failure
of R.25 engines of MIG-21
*25. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
 Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Russian experts
have joined the probe into the failure of the
R.25 engines of the MIG-21 alongwith
technical experts from the Indian Air Force
and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited;
(b) if so, whether a senior Russian
official has indicated that the sub-standard
spare parts was one of the reasons for the
high number of MIG-21 crashes in India in
recent years;
(c) if so, whether any inquiry has been
conducted by both Indian and Russian
Governments about the defective parts
supplied to India; and
(d) if so, what is the outcome of these
inquiries?
Employment for educated unemployed
youth in Assam
*26. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of steps taken by
Government to provide and create
employment opportunities for educated
unemployed youths in the rural areas of
Assam during the last three years;
(b) the details of financial allocation made
for the purpose during this period;
(c) the achievements of Government in
this regard; and
(d) the financial allocation proposed to
be made by Government for this purpose
during the Tenth Five Year Plan?
Re-deployment of troops from
International Border
*27. SHRI C. O. POULOSE:
SHRI HARENDRA SINGH
MALIK:
 Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) what were the objectives for the
deployment of troops on the International
Border;
(b) whether the deployment of troops
achieved its objectives;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government’s decision to
re-deploy the troops from International
Border indicate the improvement in the
situation which necessitated the deployment
of the troops?
Collapse of Western Grid
*28. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether in the wake of the collapse
of the Western Grid on 30th July, 2002, the
Union Government had called a meeting of
State Chief Ministers on 5th August, 2002;
(b) if so, what were the main points
discussed;
(c) whether any probe was ordered on
the grid failure;
(d) if so, what was the outcome of the
probe; and

9
WIN2\SESSION\3687RS-QUES 9
(e) what are the steps being taken to see
that such grid failure does not take place
again?
Winding up of NTC mills
*29. SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to wind up 39 NTC mills by
December this year;
(b) if so, the names of these mills and
the number of employees employed therein;
and
(c) the details of the wage arrears and
other statutory dues to the employees and
the steps being taken for clearing the dues
and also for the payment of VRS
compensation to the employees?
Meeting of MSEB, NTPC and GE
Capital on Dabhol Power Project
*30. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government had convened
a meeting of Maharashtra State Electricity
Board, National Thermal Power
Corporation and GE Capital, a promoter of
the Dabhol Power Project, on
25th September, 2002;
(b) if so, what was the main purpose of
this meeting;
(c) what were the decisions taken;
(d) whether Government had offered a
package of interest and duty concessions to
reduce Dabhol plant’s capacity costs and fuel
charges to the Maharashtra Government;
(e) if so, the concrete steps which have
been taken; and
(f) the States to whom the power would
be supplied from Dabhol Power Plant?
Ceasefire with NSCN (IM)
*31. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) what are the successes achieved and
difficulties faced by the Government
through the ceasefire with NSCN(IM);
(b) what is the present policy to contain
insurgencies in North Eastern States; and
(c) whether Government have decided
to allow Assam Government to pursue Bodo
militants in the territory of Bhutan?
Investment in NALCO
†*32. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that NALCO is  a
public sector industrial institution;
(b) if so, the date of its establishment
and the total capital investment made in this
company upto March, 2002; and
(c) the amount received as dividend by
the Government upto March, 2002 from
this company?
Safety in Mining Industry
*33. DR. KARAN SINGH:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

10
WIN2\SESSION\3687RS-QUES 10
proposal to introduce new safety measures
in mining industry; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Dialogue with cross-sections of society
in J&K
*34. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether in view of the results of
recent Jammu and Kashmir polls
Government propose to enter into
purposeful dialogue with cross-sections
of the society and organisations
like Hurriyat so that a peaceful atmosphere
is created and sustained for a long term
settlement within the Indian Constitution;
and
(b) if so, what are the plans
therefor?
Central assistance to control crimes in
NCR
*35. SHRI R. P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the States of
the National Capital Region (NCR) have
recently sought Central assistance to launch
a joint operation to eliminate hardcore
criminal gangs operating in the region
especially in Western Uttar Pradesh and
Haryana;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal and
the action taken thereon; and
(c) the details and the present status of
the proposal for creation of an NCR Police
Force mooted several years ago?
Attack on Swaminarayan Temple
*36. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a dastardly attack took place
in the Swaminarayan Temple in Gujarat in
the month of September, 2002 leading to
heavy casualties;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the probe into the
attack has since been conducted and
concluded;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether any contingency plan has
been drawn up to ensure safety of the citizens
in temples and other religious places and if
so, the details thereof; and
(f) the compensation paid to each
dependent of deceased and those
injured?
Subsidy to States for modernisation of
power plants
†*37. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have
any proposal to provide subsidy to the
States for the modernisation of power
plants;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when, the final decision is likely
to be taken in this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Implementation of Satyam Committee
Report
*38. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to a
study conducted by CII, even three years
after submitting the Satyam Committee
Report on turnaround of the ailing textile
sector, Government  have not been able to
implement as many as 88 important
recommendations;
(b) if so, what are the reasons therefor;
(c) whether this has adversely affected
the textile sector;
(d) if so, whether Government is now
considering to implement them; and
(e) if so, by when all these
recommendations will be implemented?
Bribes in recruitment in the Army
†*39. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned
“Rupye lekar sena mein bharti karaane ke
dhande ka bhandafod” which appeared in
the Rashtriya Sahara dated 23rd September,
2002;
(b) if so, Government’s reaction thereto;
(c) the number of cases of recruitments
in Army by taking bribe during the last three
years;
(d) whether Government have conducted
any re-examination of the persons recruited
to prevent recruitment of aliens and
foreigners in the Army; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Funds allocated under PMGSY to
Himachal Pradesh
*40. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the total amount sanctioned and
approved for Himachal Pradesh by the
Central Government under Pradhan Mantri
Gram  Sadak Yojana during the financial
year 2002-2003 together with the names of
the roads and the amount sanctioned for
each road;
(b) whether the construction of already
sanctioned roads has since been started, if
so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
NEW D ELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 14th November, 2002 Secretary-General.
